title: Pure Igknight
summary: Igknight Normal Pendulums paired with Ignis Phoenix, the Dracoslayer, Immortal Phoenix Gearfried, and Sublimation Knight. Every Igknight monster has a Scale 2 or Scale 7 Pendulum Effect that destroys both Igknights in your Pendulum Zones to add any FIRE Warrior from your Deck or GY to your hand while loading the face-up Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Any two Igknight monsters in the Pendulum Zones destroy themselves to search Sublimation Knight, Immortal Phoenix Gearfried, Ignis Phoenix, the Dracoslayer, or another Scale.

Sublimation Knight equips Squeaknight from the Deck on Normal Summon, and Squeaknight immediately Special Summons itself to provide two Effect Monsters for Beyond the Pendulum without using your Pendulum Summon.

Summoner's Art searches Level 5 or 6 Igknights (Margrave, Cavalier, Gallant, or Veteran), Reinforcement of the Army searches Level 3 or 4 Warriors, and Ignition Phoenix pops an Igknight to search any Igknight card.

summary.title: Opening: Any 2 Igknights + 1 Igknight or Sublimation Knight
steps: Place two Igknights in your Pendulum Zones and destroy both to search Sublimation Knight.
Normal Summon Sublimation Knight and equip Squeaknight from the Deck; Special Summon Squeaknight and link both into Beyond the Pendulum.
Beyond the Pendulum searches a missing Scale 2 or Scale 7 (such as Ignis Phoenix, the Dracoslayer), then Pendulum Summon your Igknights from the face-up Extra Deck and hand.

Tune Infernoble Knight - Renaud (or an Igknight treated as a Tuner by Ignis Phoenix) with a Level 4/7 monster into Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer, link into Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames, and deploy Immortal Phoenix Gearfried.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried banishes an Equip Spell from your field or GY to Special Summon itself from the hand, equips an opponent's monster at the start of the Damage Step, and sends an Equip Card to the GY to negate a monster effect.
Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer destroys a Pendulum Monster Card on the field (triggering Ignis Phoenix) to shuffle 1 card on the field into the Deck without targeting.

Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames revives a FIRE monster from the GY and revives itself from the GY when your opponent Special Summons by destroying a FIRE monster you control and an opponent's monster.
Beyond the Pendulum pops 2 cards on the field after you Pendulum Summon, while Majester Paladin, Red-Eyes Flare Metal Dragon, and Accesscode Talker round out the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Spells
points: Ignition Phoenix boosts all Igknights by 300 ATK/DEF and destroys 1 Igknight card in your hand or field (including Ignis Phoenix) to add any Igknight card from the Deck to the hand.
Igknight Reload reveals any number of Pendulum Monsters in your hand, shuffles them into the Deck, and draws that many cards plus 1.
